notes.title: Freiwillig Early Access Releases Today
notes.notes:
At 18:00 CET (9:00am PDT), the very first release of Freiwillig will be available for purchase and download!

We're very excited to get your feedback on this passion project to help us continue to develop Story Mode and Freeplay - as well as creating Multiplayer modes!

If you have thoughts on how to improve gameplay, how to ramp up difficulty, or how new characters could implement attacks, write us at [b]hallo@tylerist.es[/b] with your ideas.

Our hope is to put out a first update by the end of May, so let us know what you'd like to see!
